text:
maya: Quick heads-up — starting the "GPS handoff" for release v1.3.2 in the 02:00 PT change window. Need API/runtime/console/router available to coordinate. :eyes:

alex: What's the canary plan? Need concrete knobs (percent / duration) and any shard ordering.

maya: Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% if healthy. Router will be pinned to 1.3.2-rc3, runtime pinned to 1.3.2, API pinned to v1.3.2. Console will be feature-flagged (no pin). Important: drain eviction queue on shards A,B before increasing to 25%.

simon: Copy. I'll kick off staging smoke and preflight checks. Command I'll run: `/deploybot preflight --service=router --release=1.3.2`

deploybot: preflight accepted — router preflight job queued (shard A). Link: https://ci.example/reports/7012349876-preflight

casey: One note — console adds a nullable schema field; QA signed off but if we rollback we should revert router + runtime pins first, then API. Hotfix path prepared if needed.

alex: For rollback triggers let's agree: sustained 5xx > 1% for 3m OR p95 latency on api->runtime path up > 300ms compared to baseline. Rollback order agreed: router -> runtime -> api.

maya: I'll perform canary toggle after shard drain completes. Draft release-note blurb below:

```
Release v1.3.2
- Router: pinned 1.3.2-rc3
- Runtime: pinned 1.3.2
- API: v1.3.2
- Console: feature-flag rollout (no pin)
- Canary: 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100%
- Eviction drain: shards A, B required before 25% step
- Rollback criteria: 5xx >1% sustained 3m OR p95 latency +300ms
- Rollback order: router -> runtime -> api
```

simon: :thumbsup: Starting shard A drain now, will post status when A->B handoff done.

ops-bot: Deploy window open 02:00-03:30 PT. Oncall loop: @oncall-eng (pager). Keep the release thread pinned and mark any post-deploy anomalies here. :bell:
